body.heading: Today's view
paragraphs: Choose a window and draw exactly what you see: the sky, a tree, the roof across the way.
Add today's weather in the corner: a sun, a cloud, or big splashes of rain.

body.heading: A new day, a new picture
paragraphs: On a day when the weather is different, draw the same view again on a new page.
Put the pictures side by side. The window stayed the same, but the world changed its clothes.

takeaway: The same window can show a different picture every single day.
safetyNotes: Draw from inside, warm and dry, whatever the weather is doing.
screenFreeExtension: Keep a week of window pictures and make them into a weather flip-book.
